ambient_definition.ambient_operator: V_U has one physical row for every prime in U=S_left union S_right
ambient_definition.comparison_prefix_rule: fit both overlap targets at k=max(first feasible overlap prefixes)
ambient_definition.directional_target_rule: left fit uses left labels on O and left-native labels on E_left; right fit uses aligned-right labels on O and aligned-right labels on E_right
ambient_definition.strict_classification: right lower iff ratio<0.9; left lower iff ratio>1.1; otherwise unresolved

exact_theorem.common_ambient_well_defined: the union row set U and its overlap/exclusive partition are finite and disjoint
exact_theorem.common_prefix_feasibility: k=max(k_left,k_right) is feasible for both targets because prefix feasibility is nested
exact_theorem.global_sign_invariance: simultaneously negating a directional overlap and its own holdout target leaves budget and squared holdout loss unchanged
exact_theorem.holdout_separation: frontier coefficients depend only on V_O and overlap target; E is not read by the fit
exact_theorem.interval_decision_soundness: an enclosure wholly below 0.9 or above 1.1 implies the stated finite class
exact_theorem.scope: finite literal source, fixed Q spine, and directional exclusive holdout protocol
